  <h1>TGA + Fed Liquidity Intelligence</h1>
<section id="jh-liquidity-research" aria-live="polite" aria-label="US net liquidity source calculation"><p>Loading the retained source calculation…</p></section>
<aside class="liquidity-reading-note" aria-label="How to read this research">
  <h2>How to read this research</h2>
  <p>The source calculation above traces WALCL − WTREGEN − RRP to dated observations and retained originals. Wednesday assets, weekly-average TGA and daily reverse repos have different measurement periods. The resulting change is descriptive; it does not establish a causal cash flow or predict a market return.</p>
  <p>Settlement fails are a separate gross-activity measure with two distinct Treasury scopes. They are not a fourth term in the liquidity formula. Position sizing and directional Calls remain unqualified.</p>
  <p><a href="#pulse">Additional reported observations</a> · <a href="/data/liquidity-flow.json?exact=1&amp;nogen=1">Calculation packet</a></p>
</aside>

<script>
const S3_URL = 'https://justhodl-data-proxy.raafouis.workers.dev/liquidity-data.json';

const COLOR_GREEN  = '#00ff88';
const COLOR_RED    = '#ff3d5a';
const COLOR_BLUE   = '#4fc3f7';
const COLOR_ORANGE = '#ff8c42';
const COLOR_YELLOW = '#ffd700';
const COLOR_PURPLE = '#ab7df8';
const COLOR_BG     = '#0d1117';
const COLOR_TEXT2  = '#8899aa';
const COLOR_BORDER = '#1e2832';

function fmt(v, dec=1) {
  if (v === null || v === undefined || v === 'N/A') return '—';
  const n = parseFloat(v);
  if (isNaN(n)) return '—';
  return n.toFixed(dec);
}

function fmtB(v) {
  if (!v && v !== 0) return '—';
  const n = parseFloat(v);
  if (isNaN(n)) return '—';
  return '$' + n.toFixed(1) + 'B';
}

function colorVal(v) {
  if (!v && v !== 0) return '';
  const n = parseFloat(v);
  if (n > 0) return 'var(--green)';
  if (n < 0) return 'var(--red)';
  return 'var(--yellow)';
}

function signalColor(sig) {
  if (!sig) return 'var(--text2)';
  const s = sig.toUpperCase();
  if (s.includes('BULL') || s.includes('DRAIN')) return COLOR_GREEN;
  if (s.includes('BEAR') || s.includes('REBUILD')) return COLOR_RED;
  return COLOR_YELLOW;
}

function esc(value) {
  return String(value == null ? '' : value).replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));
}

function setEl(id, html) {
  const el = document.getElementById(id);
  if (el) el.innerHTML = html;
}

function echartsDefaults() {
  return {
    backgroundColor: 'transparent',
    grid: { top:30, right:20, bottom:30, left:60, containLabel: false },
    xAxis: {
      type: 'category',
      axisLine: { lineStyle: { color: COLOR_BORDER } },
      axisTick: { show: false },
      axisLabel: { color: COLOR_TEXT2, fontSize: 10 },
      splitLine: { show: false }
    },
    yAxis: {
      type: 'value',
      axisLine: { show: false },
      axisTick: { show: false },
      axisLabel: { color: COLOR_TEXT2, fontSize: 10 },
      splitLine: { lineStyle: { color: COLOR_BORDER, type: 'dashed' } }
    },
    tooltip: {
      trigger: 'axis',
      backgroundColor: '#131920',
      borderColor: COLOR_BORDER,
      textStyle: { color: '#e2e8f0', fontSize: 12, fontFamily: "'IBM Plex Mono', monospace" },
    }
  };
}

function renderMiniChart(elId, series_data, color, label) {
  const el = document.getElementById(elId);
  if (!el || !series_data || !series_data.length) return;
  const chart = echarts.init(el, null, { renderer: 'canvas' });
  const dates = series_data.map(d => d.date ? d.date.substring(0, 7) : d.date);
  const vals  = series_data.map(d => d.value);
  const opt = {
    ...echartsDefaults(),
    grid: { top:20, right:16, bottom:28, left:64 },
    xAxis: { ...echartsDefaults().xAxis, data: dates },
    yAxis: { ...echartsDefaults().yAxis, scale: true },
    series: [{
      name: label,
      type: 'line',
      data: vals,
      smooth: true,
      lineStyle: { color, width: 2 },
      areaStyle: { color: { type:'linear', x:0,y:0,x2:0,y2:1,
        colorStops:[{offset:0,color:color+'40'},{offset:1,color:color+'05'}] } },
      symbol: 'none',
    }],
    tooltip: {
      ...echartsDefaults().tooltip,
      formatter: p => `${p[0].name}<br/>${label}: ${fmt(p[0].value, 2)}`,
    }
  };
  chart.setOption(opt);
  window.addEventListener('resize', () => chart.resize());
}

function renderNetLiqChart(elId, net_liq, fed_bs, tga, rrp) {
  const el = document.getElementById(elId);
  if (!el || !net_liq || !net_liq.length) return;
  const chart = echarts.init(el, null, { renderer: 'canvas' });
  const dates = net_liq.map(d => d.date);
  const aligned = (rows, maxDays) => dates.map(day => {
    const row = [...(rows || [])].reverse().find(r => r.date <= day);
    return row && Date.parse(day)-Date.parse(row.date) <= maxDays*86400000 ? row.value : null;
  });
  const opt = {
    ...echartsDefaults(),
    legend: {
      data: ['Net Liquidity', 'Fed BS', 'TGA', 'RRP'],
      textStyle: { color: COLOR_TEXT2, fontSize: 10 },
      top: 0
    },
    tooltip: {
      ...echartsDefaults().tooltip,
      trigger: 'axis',
      formatter: params => {
        let s = `${params[0].name}<br/>`;
        params.forEach(p => { s += `${p.marker}${p.seriesName}: $${fmt(p.value,1)}B<br/>`; });
        return s;
      }
    },
    xAxis: { ...echartsDefaults().xAxis, data: dates },
    yAxis: { ...echartsDefaults().yAxis, scale: true },
    series: [
      {
        name: 'Net Liquidity',
        type: 'line',
        data: net_liq.map(d => d.value),
        lineStyle: { color: COLOR_GREEN, width: 3 },
        areaStyle: { color: { type:'linear', x:0,y:0,x2:0,y2:1,
          colorStops:[{offset:0,color:'#00ff8840'},{offset:1,color:'#00ff8805'}] } },
        symbol: 'none', smooth: true,
      },
      {
        name: 'Fed BS',
        type: 'line',
        data: aligned(fed_bs, 7),
        lineStyle: { color: COLOR_BLUE, width: 1.5, type: 'dashed' },
        symbol: 'none', smooth: true,
      },
      {
        name: 'TGA',
        type: 'line',
        data: aligned(tga, 7),
        lineStyle: { color: COLOR_RED, width: 1.5, type: 'dashed' },
        symbol: 'none', smooth: true,
      },
      {
        name: 'RRP',
        type: 'line',
        data: aligned(rrp, 3),
        lineStyle: { color: COLOR_ORANGE, width: 1.5, type: 'dashed' },
        symbol: 'none', smooth: true,
      }
    ]
  };
  chart.setOption(opt);
  window.addEventListener('resize', () => chart.resize());
}

let lastAgentPacket = null;
let lastAgentUsable = null;
function render(data) {
  lastAgentPacket = data;
  const projection = JHLiquidityLegacyQuality.project(data);
  const {usable, published_at} = projection.quality;
  lastAgentUsable = usable;
  data = projection.view;
  const snapshotStatus = document.getElementById('liquidity-agent-status');
  if (snapshotStatus) snapshotStatus.textContent = (usable
    ? 'Earlier agent measurements · heuristic scores and directional calls remain unvalidated. '
    : 'Current agent measurements unavailable · all current tiles and tables below are withheld. Charts retain the earlier snapshot. ')
    + (published_at ? 'Snapshot generated '+published_at+'. ' : 'Publication time is unknown. ')
    + 'The source calculation above has its own observation and acquisition dates.';
  try { renderCatalog(usable ? (data.catalog || {}) : {}); } catch(e){ console.error('catalog render', e); }
  try { renderPart4(usable ? (data.part4 || {}) : {}); } catch(e){ console.error("part4",e); }
  const core    = data.core    || {};
  const regime  = data.regime  || {};
  const sig     = data.spy_signal || {};
  const comps   = data.components || {};
  const tgaA    = comps.tga_analysis || {};
  const rrpA    = comps.rrp_analysis || {};
  const money   = data.money_supply || {};
  const dollar  = data.dollar || {};
  const yields  = data.yields || {};
  const funding = data.funding || {};
  const soma    = data.soma || {};
  const reserves= data.reserves || {};
  const nl      = core.net_liquidity || {};
  const charts  = data.chart_data || {};

  // Last updated
  const genAt = published_at ? new Date(published_at) : null;
  setEl('last-updated', genAt ? genAt.toLocaleString('en-US', {month:'short',day:'numeric',year:'numeric',hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit',timeZoneName:'short'}) : 'Unknown');
  setEl('footer-ts', genAt ? `Snapshot generated ${genAt.toISOString().replace('T',' ').substring(0,19)} UTC` : 'Publication time unknown');

  // Hero
  const nlVal = nl.value_bn == null ? null : Number(nl.value_bn);
  setEl('hero-net-liq', nlVal == null ? '—' : fmt(nlVal, 1));
  setEl('formula-walcl', fmtB(core.fed_balance_sheet && core.fed_balance_sheet.value_bn));
  setEl('formula-tga',   fmtB(core.tga && core.tga.value_bn));
  setEl('formula-rrp',   fmtB(core.rrp && core.rrp.value_bn));
  setEl('formula-nl',    fmtB(nl.value_bn));

  // Signal badge
  const sigLabel = nl.label || 'NEUTRAL';
  const sigBadge = document.getElementById('hero-signal-badge');
  if (sigBadge) {
    sigBadge.className = `signal-badge sig-${sigLabel}`;
    setEl('hero-signal-text', `${sigLabel.replace(/_/g,' ')} · ${nl.score == null ? 'SCORE UNAVAILABLE' : 'PROXY SCORE ' + nl.score + '/100'}`);
  }

  // Score ring
  const score = nl.score == null ? null : Number(nl.score);
  const arc = document.getElementById('score-arc');
  if (arc) {
    const scoreColor = score == null ? COLOR_TEXT2 : score >= 60 ? COLOR_GREEN : score >= 45 ? COLOR_YELLOW : COLOR_RED;
    arc.style.stroke = scoreColor;
    const circumference = 314;
    const offset = circumference - (score / 100) * circumference;
    setTimeout(() => { arc.style.strokeDashoffset = offset; }, 200);
  }
  setEl('score-num', score == null ? '—' : score);

  // Stats
  setEl('stat-regime', (regime.trend || '—').replace(/_/g,' '));
  const d4w = parseFloat(regime.delta_4w_bn);
  const d13w = parseFloat(regime.delta_13w_bn);
  setEl('stat-4w', !Number.isFinite(d4w) ? '—' : `<span style="color:${d4w>=0?COLOR_GREEN:COLOR_RED}">${d4w>=0?'+':''}${fmt(d4w,1)}B</span>`);
  setEl('stat-13w', !Number.isFinite(d13w) ? '—' : `<span style="color:${d13w>=0?COLOR_GREEN:COLOR_RED}">${d13w>=0?'+':''}${fmt(d13w,1)}B</span>`);
  setEl('stat-structure', (regime.structure || '—').replace(/_/g,' '));
  setEl('stat-curve', `<span style="color:${!yields.curve_status?COLOR_TEXT2:yields.curve_status==='INVERTED'?COLOR_RED:COLOR_GREEN}">${esc(yields.curve_status||'—')}</span>`);
  setEl('stat-sofr', funding.sofr != null ? fmt(funding.sofr,2)+'%' : '—');

  // Regime banner
  const banner = document.getElementById('regime-banner');
  if (banner) {
    banner.className = `regime-banner regime-${regime.trend || 'NEUTRAL'}`;
    const isExpanding = (regime.trend||'').includes('EXPANDING');
    const isBullish = sig.direction === 'BULLISH';
    setEl('regime-title',
      `${(regime.trend||'').replace(/_/g,' ')} REGIME · ${(regime.structure||'').replace(/_/g,' ')}`
    );
    setEl('regime-sub',
      `Net liquidity has ${isExpanding ? 'expanded' : 'contracted'} <strong>$${Math.abs(d4w).toFixed(1)}B</strong> over 4 weeks and <strong>$${Math.abs(d13w).toFixed(1)}B</strong> over 13 weeks. ` +
      `TGA signal: <strong>${(tgaA.signal||'N/A').replace(/_/g,' ')}</strong>. ` +
      `RRP signal: <strong>${(rrpA.signal||'N/A').replace(/_/g,' ')}</strong>. ` +
      `Balance-sheet proxy only; no validated SPY lead or position recommendation.`
    );
  }

  if (!Number.isFinite(d4w) || !Number.isFinite(d13w)) setEl('regime-sub', 'Required observations or aligned history unavailable; no current liquidity classification.');

  // Core triad
  setEl('walcl-val', fmtB(core.fed_balance_sheet && core.fed_balance_sheet.value_bn));
  setEl('walcl-date', core.fed_balance_sheet ? `As of ${core.fed_balance_sheet.date}` : '—');
  setEl('tga-val', fmtB(core.tga && core.tga.value_bn));
  setEl('tga-signal', `<span style="color:${signalColor(tgaA.signal)}">${(tgaA.note||'—')}</span>`);
  setEl('rrp-val', fmtB(core.rrp && core.rrp.value_bn));
  setEl('rrp-signal', `<span style="color:${signalColor(rrpA.signal)}">${(rrpA.note||'—')}</span>`);

  // SPY Signal panel
  const spyComps = sig.components || {};
  const spyCompHtml = Object.entries(spyComps).map(([k,v]) => `
    <div class="indicator-row">
      <span class="indicator-name">${k.replace(/_/g,' ').toUpperCase()}</span>
      <span class="indicator-value" style="color:${signalColor(String(v))}">${String(v).replace(/_/g,' ')}</span>
    </div>`).join('');
  setEl('spy-components', spyCompHtml);

  const spyBadge = document.getElementById('spy-direction-badge');
  if (spyBadge) {
    spyBadge.className = `signal-badge sig-${sig.direction||'NEUTRAL'}`;
    setEl('spy-dir-text', 'UNVALIDATED · NO DIRECTIONAL CALL');
  }
  setEl('spy-basis', sig.basis || '—');
  const conf = sig.validated && sig.confidence != null ? Number(sig.confidence) : null;
  setEl('spy-conf-val', conf == null ? '—' : conf + '%');
  const confBar = document.getElementById('spy-conf-bar');
  if (confBar) {
    confBar.style.width = (conf || 0) + '%';
    confBar.style.background = sig.direction === 'BULLISH' ? COLOR_GREEN : sig.direction === 'BEARISH' ? COLOR_RED : COLOR_YELLOW;
  }

  // Money supply table
  const moneyRows = [
    ['M2 Money Supply', fmtB(money.m2_bn), esc(money.date || '—')],
    ['M1 Money Supply', fmtB(money.m1_bn), ''],
    ['Monetary Base',   fmtB(money.monetary_base), ''],
    ['M2 YoY Growth',  money.m2_yoy_pct != null ? `${fmt(money.m2_yoy_pct,2)}%` : '—', ''],
  ];
  setEl('money-table', moneyRows.map(r => `
    <tr>
      <td>${r[0]}</td>
      <td class="val">${r[1]}</td>
      <td style="color:var(--text3)">${r[2]}</td>
    </tr>`).join(''));

  // Dollar table
  const dollarRows = [
    ['Fed Broad USD Index',  fmt(dollar.broad_index,2),  dollar.trend_4w_pct != null ? `${fmt(dollar.trend_4w_pct,2)}% 4w` : '—'],
    ['vs Advanced Econ', fmt(dollar.advanced_econ,2), ''],
    ['vs Emerging Mkt',  fmt(dollar.emerging_mkt,2),  ''],
  ];
  setEl('dollar-table', dollarRows.map(r => `
    <tr>
      <td>${r[0]}</td>
      <td class="val">${r[1]}</td>
      <td style="color:var(--text2)">${r[2]}</td>
    </tr>`).join(''));

  // Yields table
  const yieldRows = [
    ['2-Year',   fmt(yields.y2,3)+'%',   ''],
    ['10-Year',  fmt(yields.y10,3)+'%',  ''],
    ['30-Year',  fmt(yields.y30,3)+'%',  ''],
    ['10Y-2Y Spread', fmt(yields.spread_10_2,3)+'%', `<span style="color:${(yields.spread_10_2||0)<0?COLOR_RED:COLOR_GREEN}">${yields.curve_status||'—'}</span>`],
    ['10Y-3M Spread', fmt(yields.spread_10_3m,3)+'%', ''],
    ['TIPS 10Y Real',  fmt(yields.tips_real,3)+'%', ''],
  ];
  setEl('yields-table', yieldRows.map(r => `
    <tr>
      <td>${r[0]}</td>
      <td class="val">${r[1]}</td>
      <td>${r[2]}</td>
    </tr>`).join(''));

  // Funding table
  const fundRows = [
    ['SOFR',          fmt(funding.sofr,3)+'%',    ''],
    ['Fed Funds',     fmt(funding.fed_funds,3)+'%', ''],
    ['Reserves (Fed)',fmtB(reserves.total_bn),    reserves.date || ''],
    ['Excess Reserves',fmtB(reserves.excess_bn),  ''],
    ['SOMA Total',    fmtB(soma.total_bn),         ''],
    ['SOMA Treasuries',fmtB(soma.treasuries_bn),  ''],
    ['SOMA MBS',      fmtB(soma.mbs_bn),           ''],
  ];
  setEl('funding-table', fundRows.map(r => `
    <tr>
      <td>${r[0]}</td>
      <td class="val">${r[1]}</td>
      <td style="color:var(--text3)">${r[2]}</td>
    </tr>`).join(''));

  // Charts
  renderNetLiqChart('chart-net-liq', charts.net_liquidity, charts.fed_bs, charts.tga, charts.rrp);
  renderMiniChart('chart-fed-bs', charts.fed_bs,   COLOR_BLUE,   'Fed BS ($B)');
  renderMiniChart('chart-tga',    charts.tga,       COLOR_RED,    'TGA ($B)');
  renderMiniChart('chart-rrp',    charts.rrp,       COLOR_ORANGE, 'RRP ($B)');
  renderMiniChart('chart-m2',     charts.m2,        COLOR_PURPLE, 'M2 ($B)');
}

async function loadData() {
  try {
    const res = await fetch(S3_URL + '?t=' + Date.now(), {cache:'no-store'});
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + res.status);
    const data = await res.json();
    document.getElementById('loading').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('error-banner').style.display = 'none';
    render(data);
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Liquidity load error:', err);
    document.getElementById('loading').style.display = 'none';
    const banner = document.getElementById('error-banner');
    if (banner) { banner.style.display = 'block'; banner.textContent = `⚠ ${err.message} — retrying in 30s`; }
    setTimeout(loadData, 30000);
  }
}


// ops 4409: institutional catalog renderer — credit OAS ladder, TIPS/breakevens,
// SLOOS, stress indices, dollar pairs, Fed holdings. Value + 5y z + percentile.
const CAT_META = {
  credit:        {title:"Credit — ICE BofA OAS Ladder", unit:"bp",  desc:"IG rating cuts, sector OAS, HY BB/B/CCC, EM & Euro HY. HY OAS is the cleanest canary."},
  yields:        {title:"Rates & Real Yields — Valuation Anchor", unit:"%", desc:"TIPS real yields, breakevens, 5y5y forward, Kim-Wright term premium, curve."},
  stress:        {title:"Financial Stress & Bank Lending (SLOOS)", unit:"", desc:"NFCI/ANFCI, STLFSI, OFR FSI, and SLOOS tightening standards."},
  dollar:        {title:"Dollar Complex", unit:"", desc:"Broad USD, AFE/EME, and bilateral pairs (EUR/JPY/CNY/KRW/BRL)."},
  soma:          {title:"Fed Securities Held (H.4.1 / SOMA)", unit:"B USD", desc:"Treasury maturity/type ladder, TIPS, bills, agency, MBS."},
  fed_balance_sheet:{title:"Fed Balance Sheet & Backstops", unit:"B USD", desc:"Total assets, repo, swap lines, foreign official holdings."},
  money_supply:  {title:"Money Supply & Velocity", unit:"", desc:"M1, M2, monetary base, M2 velocity, currency in circulation."},
  reserves:      {title:"Reserve Balances", unit:"B USD", desc:"Reserves at Fed, excess reserves — the ample-reserves regime."},
  funding:       {title:"Funding Rates", unit:"%", desc:"SOFR, EFFR, OBFR, IORB, discount window."}
};
function zColor(z){ if(z==null) return 'var(--text3)'; if(z>=1.5) return 'var(--red)'; if(z>=0.75) return 'var(--amber,#e0a030)'; if(z<=-1.5) return 'var(--green)'; return 'var(--text2)'; }
function renderCatalog(catalog){
  const host=document.getElementById('catalog-section');
  if(!host) return;
  if(!catalog||!Object.keys(catalog).length){ host.innerHTML=''; return; }
  const order=['credit','yields','stress','dollar','soma','fed_balance_sheet','money_supply','reserves','funding'];
  let html='<h2 style="font-size:18px;margin:8px 0 4px">Institutional Series Catalog</h2>'+
           '<div style="color:var(--text3);font-size:12px;margin-bottom:12px">Observed values with sample z-scores and percentiles. Each series shows its actual history window; these are not forecasts.</div>';
  for(const cat of order){
    const rows=catalog[cat]; if(!rows||!Object.keys(rows).length) continue;
    const m=CAT_META[cat]||{title:cat,unit:'',desc:''};
    html+=`<div style="margin:16px 0 6px"><div style="font-weight:600;font-size:14px">${esc(m.title)}</div><div style="color:var(--text3);font-size:11px">${esc(m.desc)}</div></div>`;
    html+='<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(220px,1fr));gap:8px">';
    for(const sid of Object.keys(rows)){
      const r=rows[sid];
      const zc=zColor(r.z);
      html+=`<div style="background:var(--card,#12161c);border:1px solid var(--border,#222);border-radius:8px;padding:10px" title="${esc(sid)} · ${esc(r.label)} · ${esc(r.date||'')}">
        <div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text3);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis">${esc(r.label)}</div>
        <div style="display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between;margin-top:4px">
          <span style="font-size:18px;font-weight:600">${fmt(r.value, r.unit==='bp'?0:2)}<span style="font-size:10px;color:var(--text3)"> ${esc(r.unit||'')}</span></span>
          <span style="font-size:12px;color:${zc}">z ${r.z==null?'—':(r.z>0?'+':'')+r.z}</span>
        </div>
        <div style="height:4px;background:var(--border,#222);border-radius:2px;margin-top:6px;overflow:hidden">
          <div style="height:100%;width:${Math.max(0,Math.min(100,r.percentile||0))}%;background:${zc}"></div>
        </div>
        <div style="font-size:10px;color:var(--text3);margin-top:3px">${r.percentile==null?'Statistics unavailable':r.percentile+'%ile'} · ${esc(r.statistics_window?.start||'')} to ${esc(r.statistics_window?.end||r.date||'')} (${r.statistics_window?.observations||0} obs.)</div>
      </div>`;
    }
    html+='</div>';
  }
  host.innerHTML=html;
}

// ops 4421: Part-4 renderer — DXY hero · credit-first sequencing · global 4-CB stack
function renderPart4(p4){
  const host=document.getElementById('part4-section'); if(!host) return;
  if(!p4||!Object.keys(p4).length){host.innerHTML='';return;}
  const e=(s)=>String(s==null?'':s).replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));
  const n=(v,d)=>(v==null||!isFinite(v))?'\u2014':Number(v).toLocaleString(undefined,{maximumFractionDigits:d==null?1:d});
  let h='';
  const d=p4.dxy||{};
  if(d.level!=null||d.z!=null){
    const zc=d.z==null?'var(--text2,#aaa)':(d.z>=1.5?'#e05252':d.z<=-1.5?'#4caf7d':'#e0a030');
    h+='<div style="border:1px solid var(--border,#222);border-radius:10px;padding:14px;margin-bottom:12px;background:var(--card,#12161c)">'
      +'<div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text3,#888);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.5px">Dollar \u2014 first-class</div>'
      +'<div style="display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:4px">'
      +'<span style="font-size:30px;font-weight:700">'+n(d.level,2)+'</span>'
      +'<span style="font-size:13px;color:'+zc+'">z '+(d.z==null?'\u2014':(d.z>0?'+':'')+d.z)+'</span>'
      +(d.percentile!=null?'<span style="font-size:12px;color:var(--text3,#888)">'+d.percentile+'th percentile in available history</span>':'')
      +(d.regime?'<span style="font-size:12px;padding:2px 8px;border:1px solid var(--border,#222);border-radius:12px">'+e(d.regime)+'</span>':'')
      +'</div><div style="font-size:10px;color:var(--text3,#888);margin-top:6px;font-style:italic">'+e(d.note||'')+'</div></div>';
  }
  const cs=p4.credit_first_sequence;
  if(cs&&cs.stages){
    h+='<div style="border:1px solid var(--border,#222);border-radius:10px;padding:14px;margin-bottom:12px;background:var(--card,#12161c)">'
      +'<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px">'
      +'<span style="font-weight:600;font-size:14px">Credit-First Sequencing</span>'
      +'<span style="font-size:12px;color:'+(cs.current_stage>0?'#e0a030':'#4caf7d')+'">'+e(cs.verdict||'')+'</span></div>'
      +'<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(190px,1fr));gap:8px;margin-top:10px">';
    cs.stages.forEach(function(s){
      const c=s.fired?'#e05252':'var(--border,#222)';
      h+='<div style="border:1px solid '+c+';border-radius:8px;padding:9px">'
        +'<div style="font-size:10px;color:var(--text3,#888)">STAGE '+s.stage+'</div>'
        +'<div style="font-size:12px;margin-top:2px">'+e(s.name)+'</div>'
        +'<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;margin-top:4px">'
        +'<span style="font-size:16px;font-weight:600">'+n(s.value,2)+'</span>'
        +'<span style="font-size:11px;color:'+(s.fired?'#e05252':'#4caf7d')+'">'+(s.fired==null?'unavailable':s.fired?'threshold exceeded':'below threshold')+(s.z!=null?' \u00b7 z '+s.z:'')+'</span>'
        +'</div></div>';
    });
    h+='</div><div style="font-size:10px;color:var(--text3,#888);margin-top:8px;font-style:italic">'+e(cs.brain_rule||'')+'</div></div>';
  }
  const gr=p4.global_research||{},ga=(Date.now()-Date.parse(gr.generated_at))/3600000;
  const st=gr.status==='descriptive'&&Number.isFinite(ga)&&ga>=0&&ga<=26?(p4.global_stack_usd_bn||{}):{};
  if(Object.keys(st).length){
    let tot=0; Object.keys(st).forEach(function(k){ if(isFinite(st[k])) tot+=st[k]; }); if(!tot) tot=1;
    const cols=['#4a7dbf','#4caf7d','#c98b3a','#a05aa0','#777'];
    h+='<div style="border:1px solid var(--border,#222);border-radius:10px;padding:14px;background:var(--card,#12161c)">'
      +'<div style="font-weight:600;font-size:14px">Three-bank balance-sheet subtotal</div>'
      +(p4.three_bank_total_usd_bn!=null?'<div style="font-size:22px;font-weight:700;margin-top:4px">$'+n(p4.three_bank_total_usd_bn,0)+'B</div>':'')
      +'<div style="display:flex;height:22px;border-radius:5px;overflow:hidden;margin-top:10px">';
    Object.keys(st).forEach(function(k,i){ const w=Math.max(1,(st[k]/tot)*100);
      h+='<div title="'+e(k)+'" style="width:'+w+'%;background:'+cols[i%cols.length]+'"></div>'; });
    h+='</div><div style="display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:8px">';
    Object.keys(st).forEach(function(k,i){ h+='<span style="font-size:11px"><span style="display:inline-block;width:9px;height:9px;background:'+cols[i%cols.length]+';border-radius:2px;margin-right:4px"></span>'+e(k)+' $'+n(st[k],0)+'B</span>'; });
    h+='</div><p>'+e(p4.global_stack_note||'Three-bank subtotal only.')+'</p><a href="/global-liquidity.html">Inspect native balances, FX contributions and original sources</a></div>';
  }
  if(p4.join_notes&&p4.join_notes.length) h+='<div style="font-size:10px;color:var(--text3,#888);margin-top:8px">joins pending: '+e(p4.join_notes.join(' \u00b7 '))+'</div>';
  host.innerHTML=h;
}

loadData();

}, 60000);

(function(){function sweep(){try{var w=document.createTreeWalker(document.body,NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT),n;
while((n=w.nextNode())){if(/\b(NaN|Infinity|undefined)\b/.test(n.nodeValue)){n.nodeValue=n.nodeValue.replace(/\b(NaN|Infinity|undefined)\b/g,'\u2014');}}}catch(e){}}
